text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Alrighty then. Marvelous, time 
to change and go to bed~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Marvelous? What's up? You're reading 
that pretty intently.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"It's ‘Tales of Planet Marvelous’☆ Written 
by Marvelous Sunday... a total 
masterpiece~★"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I have a lot of things to say, but 
yeah. Let's just sleep for now. Yeah, 
let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Okay, I get it. This is a dream. 
Definitely.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because it's a dream, it's Marvelous☆ 
Starting today, you're Marvelous too★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ma, ma, ma~! Marvelouuuus☆ La, la, la~! 
Marvelouuuus★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gyah!? My body is moving on its own...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? What is this footwork...? It's 
putting no strain on my legs at all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If I pull this off in a race—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Honestly, that dream just now was 
way too crazy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ... Guess I'll go for a run for now...

From that day on, Nice Nature's running 
reached a whole new level of polish...!
